program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((markers (find-color g 9))
         (p1 (first markers))
         (p2 (second markers))
         (dr (- (fst p2) (fst p1)))
         (dc (- (snd p2) (snd p1)))
         (without-markers (map-grid g (lambda (r c v) (if (= v 9) 0 v))))
         (objs (objects without-markers 0))
         (smallest
           (first
             (sort objs
               (lambda (a b)
                 (let ((ba (obj-bbox a))
                       (bb (obj-bbox b)))
                   (cond
                     [(not (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))) (< (obj-size a) (obj-size b))]
                     [(not (= (first ba) (first bb))) (< (first ba) (first bb))]
                     [(not (= (second ba) (second bb))) (< (second ba) (second bb))]
                     [else (< (obj-color a) (obj-color b))])))))))
    (paint-cells
      without-markers
      (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (fst p) dr) (+ (snd p) dc))) (obj-cells smallest))
      (obj-color smallest))))
